hypotheses.statement: Existing G9 records/rules/cycle/effect-reference semantics plus a typed host DB adapter are sufficient for the tested CRUD and transaction service without a database-specific core primitive.
hypotheses.falsifier: A target-host application requires an observable DB semantic distinction that cannot be represented in existing canonical IR or typed adapter contracts.

hypotheses.statement: Transaction intent belongs in canonical Clay IR while BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK mechanics may remain backend lowering/adapter behavior.
support: unique-constraint failure rolled back the entire tested transaction
unsupported operation also rolled back the prior mutation
SQLite primary documentation independently defines explicit COMMIT/ROLLBACK transaction behavior
hypotheses.falsifier: Cross-backend differential shows backend mechanics alter declared Clay transaction semantics without an expressible contract field.

hypotheses.statement: Value binding must preserve data/code separation at the DB boundary rather than concatenate user values into SQL text.
support: SQL-looking payload roundtripped literally and table remained valid
SQLite primary API supports host parameters bound separately from statement text
hypotheses.falsifier: A required query class cannot be safely represented by typed query structure plus parameter binding and requires untyped SQL interpolation.

hypotheses.statement: Host-injected adapter possession is a useful runtime authority boundary but the current unrestricted Python process is not a production capability sandbox.
counterevidence: Python target remains capable of ambient imports if malicious/generated differently
hypotheses.falsifier: Run the same IR in a no-ambient-authority runtime and demonstrate denied access outside explicitly granted DB resources while preserving normal DB utility.

hypotheses.statement: The same canonical DB service semantic hash should lower equivalently to at least two physical database adapters without changing Clay semantic identity.
hypotheses.next_test: Matched SQLite plus PostgreSQL/DuckDB adapter differential on target Ubuntu with transaction/error/type semantics and receipts.

counterhypotheses.statement: Database semantics require new ClayCode core syntax/primitives rather than compiler/runtime/stdlib/FFI work.
A typed host adapter necessarily contaminates deterministic generated-program identity with runtime resource identity.
counterhypotheses.result: NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_TESTED_CLASS; generated target hash stayed deterministic and resource instance was runtime-injected.

negative_results.statement: Initial APP-03 probe used never_implies and the focused parser rejected it because the published grammar operator production omits that construct even though current G9 source uses it.
negative_results.interpretation: Additional instance of the already-known G9 spec/grammar conformance family; not independent replication and not a reason to redesign DB semantics.

negative_results.statement: Local Python adapter injection is not proof of production authority confinement or no-ambient-authority execution.
Current execution is not the target Ubuntu FRANK host and cannot mark APP-03 passed.
